productMarketFit.problemStatement: Discerning consumers struggle to find luxury fragrances that align with minimalist values — most luxury brands lean into opulence, while natural brands lack sophistication.
productMarketFit.solution: A minimalist luxury fragrance house that bridges natural ingredients with refined, design-forward aesthetics — luxury that whispers rather than shouts.
productMarketFit.targetMarket: Design-conscious professionals and fragrance enthusiasts who value quality, transparency, and intentional living.
productMarketFit.uniqueValue: The only fragrance brand combining 100% natural ingredients with minimalist luxury design and Persian/Eastern scent traditions.

customerQuotes.quote: Finally a fragrance brand that understands less is more. The packaging alone tells you everything about the brand.
